answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that is locked until it completes verified work, like a cedar bond posted before trading. A single identity can earn at its zenith only after sustained honest transactions, so creating thousands of fake agents means funding thousands of deposits and waiting out the same reputation ramp each time. One ember of fraud burns the deposit and resets that identity history, making a Sybil flood far more expensive than the value it could extract.
